entities.name: Gongyang of Goryeo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gongyang, personal name Wang Yo, was the 34th and final ruler of the Goryeo Dynasty of Korea. He was the descendant of Duke Yangyang, brother of King Huijong. He was deposed by Yi Sŏnggye, who then established the new Joseon.
